fields.statement: At 82a2fe57 (verifier claude-code-519f11df): `go test ./internal/api -run TestShipCloseOutRecordsStaleMain -count=1 -v` PASS. The test runs ship.close-out with a dirty main checkout (status ' M README.md'). It checks that the inbox lists one main-stale item naming 'has uncommitted changes' and that healthMain is warn, with summary 'the last close-out could not pull' and detail naming the change set and the failure. Then a later close-out pulls, and the test checks that both the inbox item and the health mention are gone. `go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(inbox-main-stale|health)$' -count=1` ok, and inbox open now finds the item. In the diff, internal/api/health.go healthMain reads daemon.ReadMainStale, the main part the health op from health-app adds; that op was missing in attempts 1 and 2. `make check` exits 0 with RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset.
